_about: Fetch politeness, request/time budgets, per-domain overrides and scoring weights. Every value here is enforced in code, not advisory.
_budgets_about: Seven distinct timeouts/budgets plus three caps. A single RequestBudget object is threaded through the HTTP client; every attempt, retry and redirect hop decrements the counters. Exceeding any one raises a typed budget_exhausted error and is recorded — never a silent truncation.
_robots_about: RFC 9309 semantics: robots.txt returning 4xx means allow-all; 5xx or a network failure means DISALLOW (fail closed). Crawl-delay is honoured pipeline-wide via the shared next_allowed_at gate.
_domain_about: Cross-process coordination. min_interval_sec is the floor; the effective interval is max(min_interval_sec, robots Crawl-delay, per-domain override).

arxiv.org._why: arxiv.org robots.txt declares Crawl-delay: 15. /abs and /pdf are explicitly Allowed; /e-print, /src, /ps, /find and others are Disallowed.

rss.arxiv.org._why: Separate host from arxiv.org and serves no robots.txt (404 -> RFC 9309 allow-all). Kept slower than default anyway: it is the same organisation.

github.com._why: Three release feeds are configured; serialising them keeps well inside anonymous limits.

_breaker_about: STAGED feature — implemented after the baseline gates pass. The interface is reserved from day one so enabling it is additive.
_conditional_about: STAGED feature — ETag/Last-Modified conditional requests and body caching accelerate refresh and link-check. content_hash is computed in the BASELINE regardless, because link-check needs it to detect material change.
_scoring_about: Weights for the four scores. Scores are advisory signals recorded on every record; the accept/reject decision is made by verify.py against the thresholds below, not by a weighted sum alone.
_source_tier_about: Authority ordering from the curation rules. Recorded on every record as provenance; a lower tier does not auto-reject, it lowers quality_score.

smoke._enrich_why: Disabled by default. arxiv.org mandates Crawl-delay: 15, so enriching 12 candidates from that one source alone costs >=180s of mandatory pacing — infeasible under adapter_budget_sec. Target-page fetching is exercised deliberately by `linkcheck` instead, where the 15s delay becomes a useful test of the global limiter.
